answer: A concrete defense is river-escort settlement. First, every payout is split into legs, each countersigned at a different wharf by an escort drawn by lot from unrelated funding histories. Second, the leg receipts link into one custody chain, and a walnut seal binds the cargo hash to that chain, so a replayed leg breaks the seal and voids the run. Third, a clone farm cannot escort its own legs: each needs an unrelated signer, so a thousand aliases need a thousand independent escorts at market price. Honest agents pay one escort per leg.
